title: GateMate A1 LUT Mapping Fix: yosys↔nextpnr-himbaechel P&R + Bitstream
thermal_note: GateMate A1-EVB-2M is passively cooled; synthesis and P&R ran offline (no board connected during this run); sustained on-board tests should monitor for thermal throttling per ops/hardware-bringup-prep.md.

investigation_log.detail: synth_gatemate in yosys 0.64 does not support -abc9 flag. Flag is valid for the generic 'synth' command, not synth_gatemate. Error: 'Unknown option or option in arguments'.

Techmap successfully converted CC_LUT2 → CC_LUT4 (0 sub-4 LUT cells remaining in netlist). However nextpnr-himbaechel then rejected CC_LUT4 with: 'Cell type CC_LUT4 is unsupported'. The original task hypothesis ('nextpnr only accepts CC_LUT4') was inverted: it is CC_LUT4 that nextpnr rejects.

synth_gatemate -luttree routes through lut_tree_map.v which emits CC_L2T4/CC_L2T5 for 3+ input gates but STILL emits CC_LUT2 for 2-input gates (XOR, AND, OR). Since this design only needs 2-input XOR cells, -luttree produces the same CC_LUT2 output as default.

The original gatemate_ising_n16.json (from synth_gatemate without any workaround) passed nextpnr-himbaechel successfully with --vopt allow-unconstrained. P&R completed with 0 errors. All 16 CC_LUT2 (XOR) cells mapped to CPE_LT primitives internally by nextpnr-himbaechel's GateMate uarch.

root_cause_diagnosis: The LUT mismatch was a false premise. yosys 0.64 emits CC_LUT2 for this XOR-heavy design (not CC_LUT3 or CC_LUT1 as the task description assumed). nextpnr-himbaechel 0.10's GateMate uarch accepts CC_LUT2 and maps it internally to CPE cells. The reported blocker was based on prior yosys versions that emitted smaller-width LUTs (LUT1/LUT3) or incorrect testing. The actual blocker was missing --vopt allow-unconstrained for unconstrained IOs.
operator_flash_checklist: 1. Verify DirtyJTAG onboard (USB 1209:c0ca) is enumerated: lsusb | grep '1209:c0ca'
2. Verify openFPGALoader is installed: command -v openFPGALoader
4. Monitor JTAG IDCODE: should return 0x20000001 (GM1Ax) if board is live
5. After flash: power-cycle or JTAG reset to load bitstream
6. GateMate terminal state gate: gatemate_bitstream_flashed=true requires physical flash verification

rtl/lut_to_lut4.v: pre-existing techmap (CC_LUT2→CC_LUT4); not used in final flow
rtl/gatemate_ising_n16.json: pre-existing synthesis output from May 14; used for P&R

acceptance_gate_status.note: LUT mismatch resolved: original CC_LUT2 netlist accepted by nextpnr-himbaechel 0.10 GateMate uarch. P&R complete. Bitstream generated.
